visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-opening hero with headline, intro text and CTAs beside an interactive 'page health check' panel of score gauges

contentPattern.rows: row 1 holds copy and panel; each further row is one gauge metric

cells.name: Copy (row 1, cell 1)
cells.content: h1 headline, intro paragraph, CTA links (bold link = primary button, italic link = secondary)

cells.name: Panel (row 1, cell 2)
cells.content: panel title heading, run-button label as a bold paragraph, note paragraph

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = copy cell (h1 headline, intro paragraph, CTA links) and panel cell (title heading, run-button label as a bold paragraph, note paragraph); each further row is one gauge as 'Metric label | target score 0-100' (e.g. 'Performance | 100'). Omit the panel cell and metric rows for a copy-only hero

usage.description: Home page hero: large headline, supporting paragraph and two CTA buttons on the left; a carded 'Page health check' demo on the right with a Run check button, four circular score gauges (Performance, Accessibility, Best practice, SEO) and a short note.

reuseGuidance: Use where a hero needs an interactive score demo. For a plain headline hero use the base hero block. Omit the panel cell and metric rows to get a copy-only hero.
